jobs.description:
#### **ABH Riverside**

#### **Job Summary:**


The Outreach Ambassador – Homeless Services is a dynamic, field\-based role at Weingart Center, a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to ending homelessness in Los Angeles. This position blends community programming with direct outreach to individuals experiencing homelessness. Ambassadors facilitate wellness and educational activities for interim housing residents, while also engaging unhoused individuals in surrounding public areas. They work closely with LAHSA, LA County outreach teams, and site security to connect individuals to housing and support services. The role includes food distribution, documentation, caseload support, and assistance to the Program Manager in daily operations.


#### **Essential Functions:**


Conduct daily outreach in public areas, accompanied by site security, to engage unhoused individuals respectfully and safely



Walk designated routes with a clipboard to document interactions, needs, and housing interest



Complete intakes and assessments, and connect individuals to housing resources through LAHSA and partner agencies



Collaborate with LA County outreach coordinators to coordinate referrals and follow\-ups



Maintain an active caseload of 10–15 individuals, including both interim housing residents and outreach contacts



Conduct regular check\-ins to assess progress, update housing plans, and identify barriers to stability



Track client milestones such as document readiness, housing application status, and service referrals



Develop and lead monthly activity calendars (e.g., workshops, fitness, arts, life skills) for interim housing residents



Promote participation through flyers, announcements, and one\-on\-one engagement



Organize and distribute meals/snacks to residents and outreach contacts



Track food inventory and coordinate with vendors and volunteers for safe delivery



Maintain accurate case notes and documentation in HMIS/Clarity



Assist the Program Manager with administrative tasks, reporting, and coordination



Uphold trauma\-informed, harm\-reduction, and culturally competent practices in all interactions


#### **Required Qualifications:**


High school diploma or equivalent (Associate or Bachelor’s in social work, psychology, or related field preferred)



1–2 years of experience in outreach, social services, or activity coordination



Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage in diverse populations



Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, mental health challenges, or substance use preferred



Must be empathetic, observant, and able to advocate effectively



Food service training or certification required (e.g., ServSafe or equivalent)



CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain)



Willingness to complete training in Trauma\-Informed Care, De\-escalation, and Harm Reduction


#### **Physical \& Mental Requirements:**


Ability to walk long distances and stand for extended periods while conducting outreach



Capable of lifting up to 25 lbs. and performing physical tasks such as bending, reaching, and carrying supplies



Strong verbal communication, reading, writing, and decision\-making skills



Comfortable working indoors, outdoors, and in diverse urban environments



Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with face\-to\-face and verbal contact


#### **About WEINGART CENTER ASSOCIATION**


As one of the best comprehensive human services organizations in the western United States, Weingart Center is committed to removing barriers that keep people from housing. With multiple Interim and Permanent Supportive Housing solutions throughout the greater Los Angeles area, Weingart Center addresses the needs of seniors, Veterans, women, members of the LGBTQAI\+ community, the formerly incarcerated, and many others experiencing homelessness. All Weingart Center housing solutions include comprehensive wraparound services, which are designed to help clients overcome challenges and clear the way for a fulfilling life.

Fremont, CA / Bay Area

**Build Your Career in Construction Project Management**

Tri Valley Striping is a rapidly growing pavement marking and roadway improvement contractor serving general contractors, developers, property owners, and municipalities across Northern California.

Our projects include commercial developments, parking garages and parking lots, multifamily housing, roadway improvements, and public infrastructure.

We are seeking a motivated **Associate Project Manager** who wants to build a long\-term career in construction project management and develop into a full Project Manager role.

This is not a purely administrative position. * Maintain project calendars, schedules, and project status information
* Communicate scheduling and project updates with customers and internal teams
* Follow up proactively on outstanding information and action items
* Attend job walks, project meetings, job starts, and final walkthroughs when needed

The YMCA of Greater New York is here for all New Yorkers — to empower youth, improve health, and strengthen community. Founded in 1852, today the Y serves a diverse population of more than half a million New Yorkers who learn, grow, and thrive through programs and services at our 24 branches. Community is the cornerstone of the Y. Together, we connect active, engaged New Yorkers to build stronger communities.  

  

To help fulfill our mission, we cultivate a culture of learning, leading, and collaboration to enhance community impact. Through our talented staff and “LEAP” career framework (Leadership, Empowerment, Accountability, Personal Growth), we are committed to a people\-first approach that fosters trust, inclusion, growth, and development for all.  

  

The Chinatown YMCA is seeking a Program Coordinator who will be responsible for developing, implementing, delivering, supervising, and evaluating the programs at the branch and/or it’s off\-sites, if applicable. The Program Coordinator will focus on program quality and service delivery as well as staff training and development, including Activity Specialists and Program Aides.

* Ensure the health, safety, and well\-being of participants in the program by providing appropriate supervision at all times.
* Maintain accurate program documentation (participant files, YS.net data entry, attendance, sign\-in/out forms, behavior reports, incident reports, and accident reports, as appropriate).
* Support the Site Director and supervise Activity Specialists, Counselors, Advisors, and Volunteers in the implementation of the Y Programs, Summer Camp Programs, and other Programs.
* Work cooperatively with professional staff, teachers, and other program and school staff.
* Promote an inclusive, welcoming, and respectful environment that embraces the diversity of all participants.
* Create and maintain a strength\-based, youth\-focused atmosphere that is consistent and sensitive to the needs of participants with learning, emotional, or behavioral differences.
* Create marketing flyers for program awareness and enrollment, update bulletin boards, and create a monthly newsletter.
* Serve as a positive role model for participants.
* Work with the Site Director to secure and maintain all equipment or supplies needed.
* Understand and communicate the YMCA’s core values and the goals of the Core Programs to participants and caregivers.
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with parents and guardians through regular communication about their child’s strengths and areas for growth.
* Actively participate in training sessions, designated meetings, and special events.
* Adhere to all Department of Health, YMCA of Greater New York, and funder standards, expectations, and regulations.

  

**Desired Skills \& Experience:**

* High School diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of hands\-on experience working in youth programs.
* General knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required. Knowledge of Access, Adobe PageMaker, and Photoshop preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills, leadership qualities, and comfortable working with diverse youth and adults.

 **Benefits:**  

The YMCA of Greater New York offers a variety of benefits to its staff members, including retirement benefits, medical, paid time off, free YMCA membership, and more! Benefit eligibility is determined by an individual’s employment status (i.e., full\-time or part\-time), tenure, and/or the number of hours scheduled to work. Click here for more information

If you would like to be a member of our dynamic team, please complete our online application and submit your résumé and a thoughtful cover letter that explains your interest in the role and our organization.

**Department**: Client Services

**Classification:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Location:** Office  

Our client is a multi\-state law firm representing national and regional banks, automobile financing lenders, hospitals, medical service providers and other lenders and financial institutions. Their clients hire them to resolve consumer and commercial debts in a professional and respectful manner.

**Position Summary**
====================

  

The Client Services Manager is the firm’s primary day\-to\-day point of contact for assigned creditor clients and is accountable for the health of those relationships. The role owns client communication, performance reporting, requirement management, and escalation resolution, and works across collections, suit preparation, litigation support, compliance, and accounting to make sure the firm delivers what each client contract and operating manual requires.

  

This is a client\-facing operations role, not a legal role. It does not involve the practice of law or the provision of legal advice; case strategy and legal determinations remain with firm attorneys. Success is measured by client retention and placement volume, accuracy and timeliness of reporting, performance against contractual service levels, and the speed with which client issues are resolved and prevented from recurring.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* Serve as the named relationship contact for assigned client portfolios, handling routine inquiries, requests, and correspondence with professional, timely, and well\-documented responses.
* Plan and lead recurring client touchpoints, including weekly or monthly operational calls and quarterly business reviews; set agendas, prepare materials, capture commitments, and follow through to closure.
* Maintain a current client requirements matrix for each account covering placement criteria, suit approval thresholds, settlement authority, contact and payment restrictions, reporting formats, and turnaround expectations; distribute changes to affected departments and confirm implementation.
* Anticipate client concerns and raise them internally before they become client complaints; keep firm leadership informed of relationship risk, satisfaction signals, and volume trends.
* Build working relationships across each client organization, not just with the primary contact, so continuity survives turnover on either side.

**Performance Reporting and Analytics**
---------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain reporting templates and recurring queries so monthly production is repeatable and not rebuilt each cycle.
* Track each client’s contractual service levels and scorecard metrics, flag trends before thresholds are breached, and coordinate documented remediation with the responsible department manager.

**Placement Onboarding and Portfolio Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate intake of new placements and file transmissions, including data mapping, field validation, exception handling, and confirmation of receipt and load.
* Work with the technical team to resolve transmission failures, data quality issues, and format changes; communicate status and expected resolution to the client without waiting to be asked.
* Manage account\-level client requests including recalls, closures, holds, media and document requests, balance and interest adjustments, disputes, bankruptcy and deceased notifications, and servicemember status.

* Own client\-forwarded escalations end to end: acknowledge quickly, investigate the underlying account and process history, document findings, and deliver a written response within the client’s required turnaround.
* Route consumer complaints and regulatory or attorney general inquiries to Compliance promptly and supply the account history and operational context needed for response.
* Support Compliance during client audits and examinations by gathering operational data, coordinating departmental responses, and tracking client\-facing commitments made in corrective action plans.
* Identify recurring escalation themes and drive root cause correction with the responsible department rather than resolving the same issue repeatedly.

**Internal Coordination and Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------

* Supervise, train, and develop client services staff; set clear expectations, distribute portfolio coverage, and maintain documented backup coverage for every account.
* Maintain standard operating procedures for client services workflows, response templates, and reporting production.

* Contribute to requests for proposal, capability presentations, and prospective client due diligence, including firm profile materials and reference reporting.
* Identify, evaluate, and adopt artificial intelligence and automation tools that improve the speed and quality of client work — including reporting production, account history research for escalations, data analysis, and drafting of client materials — and move successful pilots into documented routine use.

Artmill Group is seeking a creative, organized, and results\-oriented Digital Marketing \& Content Specialist to help tell the stories behind our work and expand the visibility of our individual brands.

This is an ideal position for someone who enjoys transforming visually compelling projects into engaging digital content. You will develop social media posts, website articles, email campaigns, project photography, and other marketing materials while helping us strengthen search visibility, generate qualified leads, and build meaningful connections with our audiences.

The successful candidate will combine strong writing and visual instincts with practical knowledge of digital marketing, analytics, SEO, and paid advertising. An appreciation for art, design, craftsmanship, or historic objects would be especially valuable.

**About Artmill Group**

Artmill Group is a collection of specialty art\-service companies serving collectors, designers, artists, museums, galleries, corporations, and other professionals.

Our services include art sourcing, custom framing, hand carving and gilding, custom object mounting, silvered and decorative mirrors, wall graphics and murals, fine\-art printing, conservation and restoration, art handling, and installation.

Our breadth of services allows our teams to manage complex projects from concept through completion. We are a collaborative, detail\-oriented organization committed to exceptional craftsmanship, thoughtful service, and enduring client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Content and Brand Storytelling**

Develop engaging content that highlights completed projects, specialized services, craftsmanship, and behind\-the\-scenes processes.

Write and edit website articles, project highlights, case studies, social media captions, email campaigns, and other marketing materials.

Adapt content for the distinct audiences and voices of the individual Artmill Group brands.

Maintain a consistent publishing calendar across multiple platforms and websites.

Coordinate with staff to identify projects, photograph work, gather technical information, and develop accurate stories.

Photograph and edit projects for use on websites, social media, email, and promotional materials.

Organize and maintain a searchable library of digital images and marketing assets.

**Social Media and Community Engagement**

Create, schedule, and publish content across platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, and YouTube.

Monitor comments, messages, engagement, and relevant industry conversations.

Grow brand awareness and cultivate relationships with collectors, designers, galleries, museums, adjusters, and other professional audiences.

Track platform performance and use insights to improve future content.

**Websites, SEO, and Lead Generation**

Create, edit, and publish content on WordPress websites.

Apply on\-page SEO practices, including keyword research, page titles, metadata, internal linking, image optimization, and content structure.

Update service pages, portfolios, project galleries, team information, and other website content.

Help improve local search visibility and maintain accurate Google Business Profiles.

Collaborate with leadership to create content that attracts qualified inquiries and supports business\-development goals.

Monitor website forms, calls, and other conversion activity to understand which campaigns and content generate leads.

**Advertising and Performance Reporting**

Assist with or manage Google Ads and paid social campaigns.

Develop campaign copy, creative assets, landing\-page content, and audience targeting.

Monitor campaign budgets, performance, and conversions.

Use GA4, Google Search Console, advertising dashboards, and social analytics to evaluate results.

Prepare concise performance reports with practical recommendations for improvement.

**Marketing Development**

Help identify new opportunities for partnerships, referral relationships, and audience growth.

Stay current with changes in digital platforms, search behavior, content formats, and marketing technology.

Use AI\-assisted tools thoughtfully for research, ideation, editing, and workflow efficiency while maintaining accuracy, originality, confidentiality, and brand voice.

**Required Qualifications**

Two or more years of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, social media, or a related role.

Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and visual storytelling skills.

Experience managing professional social media accounts.

Working knowledge of WordPress or a comparable content\-management system.

Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and website content optimization.

Experience using GA4, Google Search Console, or similar analytics tools.

Proficiency with image\-editing and design software such as Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Canva, or comparable programs.

Ability to manage multiple brands, projects, deadlines, and publishing schedules.

Strong attention to detail and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Good judgment when handling client information, project photography, and confidential materials.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, or other paid\-media platforms.

Experience with email\-marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Constant Contact, or HubSpot.

Photography and short\-form video\-production skills.

Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud.

Experience with local SEO, Google Business Profiles, and lead\-conversion tracking.

Knowledge of or interest in fine art, custom framing, conservation, interior design, architecture, museums, antiques, or luxury services.

Experience marketing multiple related brands.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, art, design, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

**What We Offer**

Competitive compensation based on experience

new_jobs.description:
**Why Us?**


At Par Health, we believe great healthcare is built on getting the essentials right. We’re looking for passionate, talented individuals who share our commitment to improving lives. With a global workforce, we lead with pride and purpose—prioritizing quality and safety while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and teamwork. Elevating the Essentials isn’t just our tagline, it’s the higher standard we live by every day.

**Job Description Summary**


The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is the commercial engine of — PAR Health’s new omnichannel inside sales organization. ISRs are responsible for driving product adoption and revenue growth across an assigned national territory by engaging targeted customers through phone, video, email, and digital channels.
  

  

There is a three\-tier ISR career framework. All three levels share the same core accountabilities and are subject to the same performance standards. Tiers differ by experience requirements, the depth and independence of the selling role, account complexity, and compensation band. Progression through the tiers is merit\-based, not tenure\-based.  

  

All ISRs will focus on driving adoption and sales growth of PRODUCTS W, X,Y,Z within the 505(b)(2\) ready\-to\-use (RTU) sterile injectable market.**Job Description**

**Responsibilities**

*Territory Sales and Customer Engagement*

* Execute a structured omnichannel selling cadence across assigned territory: phone, video detailing, email, and digital touchpoints aligned to the Project Chi engagement model
* Drive adoption of PRODUCTS W, X, Y, Z among targeted customers
* Sell on product features and benefits — communicate clinical value, formulary advantages, and RTU product differentiation with confidence
* Manage a territory of assigned accounts: track account status, buying patterns, competitive position, and next\-best\-action priorities in Salesforce CRM
* Achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual territory revenue and activity targets
* Conduct account business reviews: review performance, identify growth opportunities, and reinforce product value


60%

*CRM and Omnichannel*

* Maintain accurate, timely Salesforce CRM records for all customer interactions, pipeline activity, and account notes — within 24 hours of contact
* Leverage AI\-enabled next\-best\-action prompts (Salesforce Einstein) to prioritize outreach, personalize messaging, and select the right channel for each interaction
* Execute digital touchpoints in coordination with the Digital Marketing Manager — follow up on email campaigns, respond to digital engagement signals, and integrate digital and phone outreach seamlessly
* Actively participate in weekly ISR team huddle: share territory insights, pipeline updates, and competitive intelligence


20%

*Product Knowledge and Compliance*

* Complete all product training and sales certification before
* Maintain deep knowledge of the Par Health Sterile Injectable PRODUCTS W, X, Y, Z: clinical profile, formulation, RTU advantages, formulary status, and competitive landscape
* Deliver only FDA/OPDP\-approved promotional materials and messaging — all content must be PRC\-approved before use
* Adhere to all PAR Health compliance policies and complete required compliance training on schedule


10%

*Team Contribution and Development*

* Contribute to a high\-performance, collaborative team culture — share territory insights, support peers, and participate actively in team learning
* Engage in structured coaching sessions with the Inside Sales Manager: accept feedback, apply it, and demonstrate measurable improvement
* Take ownership of individual career progression milestones within the three\-tier framework
* Senior ISRs: provide peer mentorship to ISR and Professional ISR colleagues; contribute to onboarding of new hires


10%

**Qualifications**

*Education \& Experience*

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 1\+ year of inside sales experience required — in any B2B industry; healthcare or life sciences preferred
* Demonstrated quota attainment in a prior inside sales role
* CRM experience required; Salesforce preferred
* Experience with omnichannel selling (phone \+ digital) a strong plus

*Knowledge*

* FDA/OPDP promotional regulations and what can and cannot be communicated to healthcare professionals
* Salesforce CRM — call logging, pipeline management, and data quality
* Omnichannel engagement tools: VoIP/softphone, video detailing platforms, email, and digital messaging
* MS Office Suite; ability to read territory performance dashboards and interpret call analytics
* Hospital pharmacy and sterile injectable market fundamentals (trained at onboarding)

*Skills \& Abilities*

* Selling skills — ability to present features and benefits, handle objections, and close across phone, video, email, and digital channels
* Resilience — maintains motivation, professionalism, and activity volume through rejection and high\-volume calling days
* CRM discipline — treats accurate and timely Salesforce data entry as a professional standard
* Coachability — seeks feedback actively, applies it quickly, and demonstrates improvement
* Competitive drive — motivated by individual and team targets; brings a winning mentality while supporting teammates
* Communication — clear, concise, and credible in every channel; adapts messaging to clinical and non\-clinical buyers
* Accountability — takes ownership of territory results; escalates obstacles early with proposed solutions

**Working Conditions**

* Based in Chicago, Illinois — primary location office (TBD)
* Travel required: customer visits, trade meetings, and PAR Health headquarters
* Availability for customer/industry events that may occur on evenings or weekends

**Scope of Authority**

***Territory***


1 of 10 nationally balanced territories (similar potential and workload).

***Revenue Responsibility***


Exceed sales targets of PRODUCTS W, X, Y, Z

***Customer Segments***


Hospital
